Weights (|c₁|², |c₂|², |c₃|²) of the three basis states
Relative phases arg(c₂/c₁) across, arg(c₃/c₁) up; edges wrap around
The chosen draw ψ(x): bar height |ψ(x)|, hue its phase
Its density |ψ(x)|²: Fubini-Study Fisher-Rao on the weights
Setup: every amplitude here is ψ(x) = c₁e₁(x) + c₂e₂(x) + c₃e₃(x), with c₁ real and nonnegative (the global phase removed): e₁ is a Gaussian at x = −0.7, e₂ a Gaussian at x = 0.7 times e6ix, e₃ the signed state (x − 0.7) times a Gaussian, each made orthogonal to the ones before. A point of the triangle and a point of the square together are one amplitude.
Top, both panels: draws from the source distribution P₀; draws from the data distribution P₁; corners of the triangle, the basis states (click one); the chosen draw (click any draw in either panel to see it as a function of x).
Top, the learned field: a sample from P₀, μ₀, where each path starts; its path under the Fubini-Study field v*(ψ, t) = 𝔼[ψ̇t | ψt = ψ] (pairs matched by optimal transport under the Fubini-Study distance), ending at the outlined point ψt, coloured by t; at t = 1 these points are a generated sample of P₁; corners, the basis states (click one); the followed point (click one in either panel to follow it).
Top, Fisher-Rao on the weights (box ticked): the same μ₀ under the Fisher-Rao field on the weights: its paths, ending at its points at the current t, a second generated set; in the square, its points stay at their start, since that field never moves the phases.
Bottom: the chosen draw as an amplitude (bar height |ψ(x)|, hue its phase) and as a density; its density under Fisher-Rao on the weights (box ticked).
